<style>
html, body {
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0;
  background: #eef3f8;
  font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
  color: #172b4d;
}
.main-container {
  max-width: 1600px;
  width: 97%;
  margin: 12px auto;
  padding: 0;
}
.dashboard-header {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 180px 1fr 245px;
  align-items: center;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 9px;
  padding: 12px 24px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.12);
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.logo-box {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.moh-logo {
  max-height: 100px;
  max-width: 155px;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.who-logo {
  max-height: 90px;
  max-width: 230px;
  object-fit: contain;
}
.header-centre {
  text-align: center;
  padding: 0 12px;
}
.dashboard-title {
  font-size: 29px;
  line-height: 1.15;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #17365D;
  margin-bottom: 7px;
}
.dashboard-period {
  font-size: 14px;
  color: #52657a;
}
.navigation {
  display: flex;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  background: #17365D;
  border-radius: 7px;
  overflow: hidden;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.tab-button {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 145px;
  border: none;
  background: #17365D;
  color: white;
  padding: 13px 12px;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 13px;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.tab-button:hover {
  background: #255a91;
}
.tab-button.active {
  background: #0072BC;
}
.tab-content {
  display: none;
}
.tab-content.active {
  display: block;
}
.kpi-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr);
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.kpi-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 14px 8px;
  text-align: center;
  border-top: 4px solid #0072BC;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
}
.kpi-label {
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 600;
  color: #5b677a;
  min-height: 30px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
}
.kpi-value {
  color: #17365D;
  font-size: 24px;
  font-weight: 700;
  margin-top: 4px;
}
.kpi-small {
  color: #64748b;
  font-size: 11px;
  margin-top: 2px;
}
.section-title {
  font-size: 20px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #17365D;
  margin: 14px 2px 9px 2px;
}
.section-note {
  font-size: 12px;
  color: #64748b;
  margin: -5px 2px 10px 2px;
}
.chart-grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 12px;
}
.chart-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 12px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
  margin-bottom: 12px;
}
.full-width {
  width: auto;
}
.chart-heading-row {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
}
.chart-title {
  font-size: 16px;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #17365D;
}
.chart-subtitle {
  font-size: 11px;
  color: #697386;
  margin-top: 3px;
}
.dashboard-chart {
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  display: block;
}
.download-btn {
  display: inline-block;
  background: #0072BC;
  color: white !important;
  padding: 7px 12px;
  border-radius: 5px;
  text-decoration: none !important;
  font-size: 11px;
  font-weight: 700;
  white-space: nowrap;
}
.download-btn:hover {
  background: #005a96;
}
.table-card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 7px;
  padding: 14px;
  margin-bottom: 13px;
  box-shadow: 0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
}
.table-heading {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 10px;
  margin-bottom: 10px;
}
.footer {
  margin-top: 14px;
  padding: 12px;
  background: white;
  border-radius: 7px;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 10px;
  color: #64748b;
}
@media(max-width:1200px) {
  .kpi-grid {

  .dashboard-header {
    grid-template-columns: 140px 1fr 200px;
  }
}
@media(max-width:850px) {
  .chart-grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
  }

  }
  .dashboard-header {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 10px;
  }
  .dashboard-title {
    font-size: 23px;
  }
}

<script>
function openTab(evt, tabName) {
  var i;
  var tabcontent;
  var tabbuttons;
  tabcontent = document.getElementsByClassName("tab-content");
  for (i = 0; i < tabcontent.length; i++) {
    tabcontent[i].classList.remove("active");
  }
  tabbuttons = document.getElementsByClassName("tab-button");
  for (i = 0; i < tabbuttons.length; i++) {
    tabbuttons[i].classList.remove("active");
  }
  document.getElementById(tabName).classList.add("active");
  evt.currentTarget.classList.add("active");
  window.scrollTo({
    top: 0,
    behavior: "smooth"
  });
}
</script>
